progress.summary: Core-web launch scoping blocks production music-worker scheduling. The framework evidence is preserved, but advanced music workers remain disabled until the core release is stable and product/operations approve the launch subset.
completed: Added mandatory idempotency, retry, DLQ, health, and unscheduled registration contracts for the current worker entrypoint inventory.

Added focused framework tests covering hybrid registration, idempotency/DLQ requirements, retry terminal behavior, and degraded health.
Adopted the shared contract across the 11 existing creator outbox entrypoints through one runner implementation.
Reconciled inventory counts and classified the trust reconciler and smoke scripts outside the 21 worker registrations.
Codified the pending-approval cadence policy, five-attempt exponential retry baseline, and operator-reviewed no-auto-replay DLQ policy.
Reserved pg_cron maintenance for the future trust reconciliation path while keeping all current registrations on durable runtime and unscheduled.
Verified no migrations, Vercel schedules, pg_cron schedules, or production worker launches were added.
next_steps: Resume only after RELEASE-005 records a stable core-web launch and operations approves worker inventory, cadence, stale-work windows, retry, DLQ, and monitoring.
